name: [Beta] My Prison
desc:
LAST UPDATES: 
- 🏎️ Vehicle Nitro: Speed around your prison with the brand new car nitro boost!
-🌳 Nature Expansion: Decorate your outdoors with new Vegetation
- 🛠️ Advanced placement system allowing you to place items off-grid
- 🚨 Gang System: Factions have arrived in your facility! Manage gang activity and handle new inmate dynamics.
- 👕 CLOTHING UPDATE! Customise the style & colors of your prisoners and guards!
- 🛥️ Yacht and Wealthy Prisoners
- 🏝️ Added the brand new Island Plot
- 🚤 Introducing Water Vehicles & Boats
-🎓 School, New Tutorial and More!
-✂️ Barber System: New activity during free time + Barber Chair
- 📚 Library: Expand your prison with books and secret hidden doors

UPDATE EVERY 2 WEEKS.

It's a beta please report bugs.

👮‍♂️ Build and Manage your own prison tycoon.
😎 Visit your friends and strangers prisons
🚔 Arrest criminals
🚨 Prevent Riot and Escapes
🤑 Have the Biggest Prison

🔔 Follow for game updates! 🔔
